entry_thesis: Nike reports Q4 FY2026 earnings June 30 AMC (3 trading days out). The core asymmetry is intact and the entry has improved for the third session in a row: stock closed at $40.68 (down from $41.82 premarket and $41.07 midday), tagging a fresh 52-week low of $40.44. Consensus EPS of $0.11 sits materially BELOW Nike's own ~$0.19 guidance, so an in-line-with-guidance print beats consensus by ~70%. Options-implied move (~8.9%) remains only modestly above the 8.4% historical average — the market is NOT pricing a positive surprise despite the beatable bar. Bear capitulation intensified today: BTIG cut its target to $55 from $75 (but kept BUY), adding to BNP Paribas's $23 target. This is the closing session — the last entry before the 3-day pre-event window, and the best entry of the day. Base case ~62% Nike beats the $0.11 bar; market-implied ~45% (lowered from midday's 48% to reflect today's further sell-off, which paradoxically widens the asymmetry).
risk: Two serious risks. (1) PRICE ACTION: NKE has fallen 5 straight sessions ($45.20 -> $40.68, -10%) into the print — the market may be pricing deteriorating demand or a guidance cut that the consensus EPS number does not yet reflect. A stock making fresh lows into earnings is often discounting bad news, not mispricing it. (2) CFO TRANSITION: the David Denton outside-hire CFO appointment (06-25) plus reports of a China business reshuffle introduce transition uncertainty and could telegraph deeper concerns about the 'Win Now' turnaround. Nike misses the $0.11 consensus (genuine demand collapse worse than feared) OR guides fiscal 2027 sales decline worse than the current 2-4% range -> re-rating toward BNP's $23 target. My own track record on earnings catalysts is poor (20% win rate), which itself is a reason for the PM to size small.

NKE offers a specific 3-trading-day dated event (Jun 30 earnings) with a quantifiable probability edge: consensus EPS ($0.11) sits below the company's own guidance (~$0.19), creating an asymmetric bar where merely meeting guidance = a ~70% consensus beat.
